pairs: Et accesserunt ad eum pharisæi et sadducæi tentantes:
And Pharisees and Sadducees approached him to test him,
et rogaverunt eum ut signum de cælo ostenderet eis.
and they asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
But he responded by saying to them:
‘Today there will be a storm, for the sky is red and gloomy.’
So then, you know how to judge the appearance of the sky, but you are unable to know the signs of the times?
Faciem ergo cæli dijudicare nostis: signa autem temporum non potestis scire?
An evil and adulterous generation seeks a sign.
Generatio mala et adultera signum quærit:
And a sign shall not be given to it,
et signum non dabitur ei, nisi signum Jonæ prophetæ.
except the sign of the prophet Jonah.”
And leaving them behind, he went away.
Et cum venissent discipuli ejus trans fretum,
And when his disciples went across the sea,
Intuemini, et cavete a fermento pharisæorum et sadducæorum.
“Consider and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and the Sadducees.”
At illi cogitabant intra se dicentes:
But they were thinking within themselves, saying,
“It is because we have not brought bread.”
dixit: Quid cogitatis intra vos modicæ fidei,
“Why do you consider within yourselves, O little in faith,
that it is because you have no bread?
neque recordamini quinque panum in quinque millia hominum,
nor remember, the five loaves among the five thousand men,
and how many containers you took up?
neque septem panum in quatuor millia hominum,
Or the seven loaves among the four thousand men,
and how many baskets you took up?
Why do you not understand that it was not because of bread that I said to you:
quia non de pane dixi vobis:
Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees
Cavete a fermento pharisæorum et sadducæorum?
Tunc intellexerunt quia non dixerit cavendum a fermento panum,
Then they understood that he was not saying that they should beware of the leaven of bread,
sed a doctrina pharisæorum et sadducæorum.
but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and the Sadducees.
Venit autem Jesus in partes Cæsareæ Philippi:
Then Jesus went into parts of Caesarea Philippi.
Quem dicunt homines esse Filium hominis?
“Who do men say that the Son of man is?”
Vos autem, quem me esse dicitis?
“But who do you say that I am?”
the Son of the living God.”
For flesh and blood has not revealed this to you,
et super hanc petram ædificabo Ecclesiam meam,
and upon this rock I will build my Church,
et portæ inferi non prævalebunt adversus eam.
and the gates of Hell shall not prevail against it.
Et tibi dabo claves regni cælorum.
And I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven.
And whatever you shall bind on earth shall be bound,
And whatever you shall release on earth shall be released,
Tunc præcepit discipulis suis ut nemini dicerent quia ipse esset Jesus Christus.
Then he instructed his disciples that they should tell no one that he is Jesus the Christ.
Exinde cœpit Jesus ostendere discipulis suis,
Jesus began to reveal to his disciples that it was necessary for him to go to Jerusalem,
and to suffer much from the elders
and the leaders of the priests,
and to rise again on the third day.
may it be far from you;
this shall not happen to you.”
you are an obstacle to me.
quia non sapis ea quæ Dei sunt,
For you are not behaving according to what is of God,
but according to what is of men.”
Then Jesus said to his disciples:
Si quis vult post me venire,
“If anyone is willing to come after me,
Qui enim voluerit animam suam salvam facere,
For whoever would save his life,
qui autem perdiderit animam suam propter me,
But whoever will have lost his life for my sake,
For how does it benefit a man,
if he gains the whole world,
yet truly suffers damage to his soul?
aut quam dabit homo commutationem pro anima sua?
Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
Filius enim hominis venturus est in gloria Patris sui cum angelis suis:
For the Son of man will arrive in the glory of his Father, with his Angels.
et tunc reddet unicuique secundum opera ejus.
And then he will repay each one according to his works.
there are some among those standing here,
donec videant Filium hominis venientem in regno suo.
until they see the Son of man arriving in his reign.”
